content_en: In two years from zero to one hundred thousand ARR what magic does this note tool have. He dropped out of school twice just to make product that makes himself feel good. Dropping out once is called rebellion. Dropping out twice is called persistence. Yu-An Chan is such person. Taiwan University physics math department read one year dropped out said exploring wider interests. Then went to US Minerva university computer science department read one year dropped out again. This time to focus on making product Heptabase. A visual note tool. Now earning several million dollars annually. One. Yu-An has loved learning since childhood. Not that kind of dead studying love. Is that kind suddenly understanding complex concept brain ding sound whole body comfortable feeling. He calls this aha moment. He wants more people experience this feeling. So made Heptabase help people better learn and research complex topics. Two. At beginning he made beginner mistake. Wanted to make product perfect browser plus note tool plus publishing platform one big comprehensive thing. Result. Everything half baked cannot use at all. At that time he had no financing savings nearly ran out. He realized this road cannot work. So started over. This time he learned. Only do one thing let users create cards then reuse these cards across different whiteboards. One week launched. After several thousand iterations became what it is today.
